title: Clock one-city versus empty-city idle probe

measurement.harness: scripts/linux/measure-budgets.py with a local temporary modification that seeds cities=[] only for the empty-city run
measurement.isolation: Each launch used a private temporary HOME and XDG config/data/state/cache directories; no input was injected. The Clock window started on World view. Runs were sequential under /tmp/lulo-journey.lock.

runs.state: missing state file; Clock initialized its normal local-city fallback
seeded private clock.json with cities=[]; no city faces or moving second hands

interpretation: Both modes retain the once-per-second World ClockView ticker, and both measured 3.117 wake-ups/s. Removing the single city lowered CPU by about 0.117 percentage points (0.550% to 0.433%), so the city face is a small part of the measured cost. Both still exceed the 0.3% budget. This is a focused probe and does not replace the nine-app candidate release table.
